_comment: Site-wide settings shared by scheduler_service.py and reasoning_agent.py. Location names here are the ONLY names the LLM may use and the only ones the scheduler will accept. Each robot agent maps these names to its own vendor targets (MiR mission GUIDs, UR programs) in agents/*.json. A QC location with "conveyor" is inspected on a conveyor: the robot places the part on the belt there, and picks it up again at the belt exit -- at the same location, or at conveyor.exit_location if the arm cannot reach the exit from there. Remove "conveyor" if parts are inspected while the robot holds them.
